remarks: Brand new construction with all utilities and high-speed internet included, making budgeting simple and predictable. Be the first to call this beautifully finished 2 bedroom apartment home. Located in desirable North Stamford, this residence offers the rare combination of modern living, privacy, and an exceptionally comprehensive rental package. The thoughtfully designed 780 square foot home features 2 bedrooms, central air conditioning, new stainless steel appliances, and ample closet space, creating a comfortable and efficient living environment. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer/dryer along with a dedicated covered car port parking space. Situated above a newly constructed detached garage, this residence provides the peace of mind and appeal of being the very first occupant. Experience the tranquility of North Stamford while remaining conveniently close to shopping, dining, recreation, and major commuter routes.
